name: Lanthanum barium cuprate, x = 0.125
equilibrium_context: Tc about 4 K, superconductivity almost extinguished at the point of the 1/8 anomaly; charge and spin stripe order
summary: Negative result. It is in the registry because a registry without non-detections cannot represent the state of the controversy.

driven_states.emergent_property: Near-infrared excitation melts the competing stripe orders and does produce a pump-induced reflection edge along c, but at the same time the in-plane reflectivity decreases, which points to increased quasiparticle scattering rather than to condensate formation. The in-plane response is qualitatively different from a superconducting condensation.
driven_states.source: Zhang et al., Phys. Rev. X 14, 011036 (2024), doi:10.1103/PhysRevX.14.011036
driven_states.caveat: A non-detection under the chosen conditions, not proof of absence. The authors argue that pump photon energies far above the superconducting gap cannot in principle produce three-dimensional superconductivity - this does not rule out the mid-IR phonon-resonant route of Fausti 2011. Conversely, a Comment by the Cavalleri group disputes the data analyzis. Composition and pump conditions differ from LBCO x = 0.115.
further_sources: Nicoletti et al., Phys. Rev. B 90, 100503 (2014)
driven_states.measured_quantity: reflectivity in the plane and along c
